changelog:
To-do list fixes.

You can create a to-do list without connecting Google. Previously this failed outright with "Connect Google Tasks first" - which became the normal case once Google syncing was switched to opt-in. A list is just a name; it doesn't need a cloud account.

A new empty list now stays put. Lists were only remembered through the to-dos filed in them, so a list you'd just created disappeared as soon as you looked away - which looked exactly like the list never being created at all.

Deleting a list now asks what to do with its to-dos: keep them (they become unfiled) or delete them too. It tells you how many, and an empty list is just deleted without the question.

If you connect Google Tasks later, lists you made offline are pushed up then - matched by name, so you don't end up with two copies of a list you already had there.
